description: Polarized photon-determinant leg of α_EM 1/(8π): with the exact period τ_B=τ₀·M (Thm 2.12), det(M)=125=det(diag(5,5,5,1)) and spec(M)={1,5,5,5}=spec(diag) ⇒ polarized and product forms share covolume+metric spectrum (O(4)-equiv). assertions.name: covolume_polarization_independent
assertions.detail: det(M)=125.0=125=det(diag(5,5,5,1)), tr(M)=16 ⇒ the polarized Jacobian covolume equals the product-form covolume (Im(τ₀)⁴·125)

assertions.name: spectrum_is_1_5_5_5_O4_equivalent
assertions.detail: det(M−I)=0≈0, det(M−5I)=0≈0, tr(M²)=76.0=76 (=1²+3·5²) ⇒ spec(M)={1,5,5,5}=spec(diag(5,5,5,1)): M is O(4)-equivalent to the product form (same det, same metric spectrum)

assertions.name: naive_product_measure_recorded_not_interpreted
assertions.detail: m(5τ₀)³·m(τ₀)=8.2262852 (≈8.226) — the PRODUCT-lattice measure; recorded for comparison. NOT interpreted: 8.226≠8=b₁, and Prop 4.6 says the product is not the principally-polarized decomposition, so this is not the polarized photon determinant. No fitting.

assertions.name: polarized_reduces_to_theta_factor_of_M_lattice
assertions.detail: since det(M)=det(diag) and spec(M)=spec(diag), the polarized boson determinant differs from the naive product ONLY through the genus-4 theta-factor (higher-η analog) of the INTEGER lattice Z⁴+τ₀M·Z⁴ vs the product lattice — the single well-posed remaining object (Epstein/Kronecker ζ'(0) = Faltings/Ray-Singer invariant of the polarized Jacobian). This is the precise deferred computation
